launch-desk.title: Ferngrove cuts 2,000 jobs
launch-desk.author: Theo Marsh
body: [f01: Ferngrove is cutting 2,000 jobs.] [f02: That's about 4% of its workforce.]
[f03: Most of the cuts land on Hearth, the company's smart home division.] That says a lot about where Ferngrove now sees its future.
[f04: Ferngrove expects to book $310 million in charges, most of it for severance.] The costs arrive right away. The savings will take longer to show up.
Investors will want to hear what Ferngrove plans to do with the money it saves, and whether more cuts are coming.

byteward.title: Ferngrove to cut 2,000 jobs
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: Ferngrove plans to lay off about 2,000 employees.] [f05: CEO Lena Marchbanks announced the cuts in a memo to staff.]
[f03: Most of the affected jobs are in Hearth, the company's smart home unit.] [f06: Ferngrove will also stop selling its Hearth Panel smart display.]
[f07: Laid-off workers will get at least 16 weeks of pay.] [f08: It's the company's second round of cuts this year, after 900 jobs went in March.]

wirefold.title: Ferngrove cutting 2,000 jobs
body: Ferngrove is cutting about 2,000 jobs, most of them in its smart home business, the company said.
